channel.title: Claude Code Live Cheatsheet
channel.description: Auto-updating cheatsheet for Claude Code — keyboard shortcuts, commands, tips, and more.

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.183 highlights
item.description:
• Auto mode blocks destructive git/terraform commands without explicit request (v2.1.183)
  • attribution.sessionUrl omits claude.ai session link from commits/PRs (v2.1.183)
  • /config --help lists all available shorthand keys (v2.1.183)
  • /config toggle: Enter and Space change setting; Esc saves and closes (v2.1.183)
  • Warning when requested model is deprecated or auto-updated (v2.1.183)
  • /config key=value syntax sets any setting from prompt (v2.1.181)
  • sandbox.allowAppleEvents opt-in for macOS sandboxed Apple Events (v2.1.181)

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.183
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] attribution.sessionUrl: Omit claude.ai session link from commits and PRs in web/RC sessions
~ [slash-commands] /config: Open settings; key=value sets any setting; --help lists shorthand keys
- [config-env] footerLinksRegexes

Full changelog

• Improved auto mode safety: destructive git commands (`git reset --hard`, `git checkout -- .`, `git clean -fd`, `git stash drop`) are now blocked when you didn't ask to discard local work, `git commit --amend` is blocked when the commit wasn't made by the agent this session, and `terraform destroy`/`pulumi destroy`/`cdk destroy` are blocked unless you asked for the specific stack
• Added a warning when the requested model is deprecated or automatically updated to a newer model, shown on stderr in print mode (`-p`) and now also covering models set in agent frontmatter
• Added `attribution.sessionUrl` setting to omit the claude.ai session link from commits and PRs in web and Remote Control sessions
• Added `/config --help` to list all available shorthand keys for `/config key=value`
• Changed `/config` toggle behavior: Enter and Space both change the selected setting, and Esc now saves and closes instead of reverting
• Removed the startup "setup issues" line under the logo — run `/doctor` to see configuration issues or use `--debug`
• Fixed `thinking.disabled.display: Extra inputs are not permitted` 400 errors on subagent spawns and session-title generation for affected configurations
• Fixed WebSearch returning empty results in subagents
• Fixed the terminal cursor being stranded above the prompt after navigating history in vim mode with the native cursor enabled
• Fixed fullscreen TUI corruption (statusline mid-screen, duplicated spinner rows, merged text) in Windows Terminal under heavy nested-subagent load
• Fixed turns silently completing with no visible output when the model returned only a thinking block; Claude now re-prompts once
• Fixed user-level skills appearing multiple times in slash-command autocomplete when multiple plugins are enabled
• Fixed MCP servers requiring authentication exposing auth-stub tools to the model in headless/SDK mode
• Fixed tmux teammate panes failing to launch when the shell has slow rc-file initialization, and keystrokes typed during agent spawn leaking into the new tmux pane instead of the leader prompt
• Fixed background tasks started by a teammate being killed when the teammate finishes a turn
• Fixed scheduled task and webhook trigger deliveries being treated as keyboard input; they now classify as task notifications and can no longer approve a pending action or set the session title in auto mode
• Fixed focus mode showing "Ran N PostToolUse hooks" timing lines under each response

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.181
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] sandbox.allowAppleEvents: Opt-in: let sandboxed commands send Apple Events on macOS
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CLIENT_PRESENCE_FILE: Marker file to suppress push notifications while at the machine
~ [slash-commands] /config: Open settings; key=value sets any setting
- [config-env] OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES
- [config-env] API_FORCE_IDLE_TIMEOUT

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.178
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [skills-agents] Nested .claude/skills: Nested skill dirs load; clashes show as <dir>:<name>
+ [skills-agents] Nested .claude/ priority: Agent/workflow/output-style closest to cwd wins on collision
~ [config-env] deny: tool-name glob: * denies all; Tool(param:value) matches input params; allow rejects non-MCP
~ [config-env] workflowKeywordTrigger: Explicit phrases only ('run a workflow', 'workflow:'); purple shimmer
~ [workflows-tips] Dynamic workflows: Orchestrates tens–hundreds of agents; triggers on 'run a workflow', 'workflow:'

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.176
item.description:

+ [config-env] language: Pin session title language (overrides auto-detection)
+ [config-env] footerLinksRegexes: Regex-matched link badges in footer row (user or managed)
- [config-env] wheelScrollAccelerationEnabled
- [config-env] terminalSequence

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.175
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

item.description:

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.172
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [skills-agents] Nesting depth: Sub-agents can spawn their own sub-agents up to 5 levels deep

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.169
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [cli-flags] --safe-mode: Start with all customizations disabled (CLAUDE.md, plugins, skills, hooks, MCP)
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_SAFE_MODE: Env var equivalent of --safe-mode flag
+ [slash-commands] /cd [path]: Move session to new working directory without breaking prompt cache
+ [config-env] disableBundledSkills: Hide bundled skills, workflows, and built-in slash commands from model
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BUNDLED_SKILLS: Env var equivalent of disableBundledSkills setting
+ [config-env] API_FORCE_IDLE_TIMEOUT: Opt out of default 5min idle timeout on Vertex/Foundry (set to 0)
~ [cli-flags] claude agents --json: List live sessions as JSON; --all includes completed; id/state fields
- [config-env] MessageDisplay
- [config-env] reloadSkills
- [config-env] sessionTitle
- [config-env] WorktreeCreate

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.166
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] fallbackModel: Up to 3 fallback models tried in order when primary is overloaded
+ [config-env] deny: tool-name glob: * denies all tools; allow rules reject non-MCP globs
+ [cli-flags] --thinking: disabled turns off thinking on models that think by default
~ [cli-flags] --fallback-model: Fallback when primary unavailable (interactive + headless)
~ [config-env] MAX_THINKING_TOKENS: 0=off; disables thinking on models that think by default
- [config-env] pluginSuggestionMarketplaces
- [config-env] allowAllClaudeAiMcps

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.163
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [slash-commands] /plugin list [--enabled|--disabled]: List installed plugins with status filters
+ [config-env] requiredMinimumVersion / requiredMaximumVersion: Managed settings; refuses start if version outside allowed range
+ [config-env] hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: Stop/SubagentStop: give Claude feedback, continue turn
+ [skills-agents] \$: Escape literal $ before digit in command bodies
~ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID: Session ID passed to stdio MCP server subprocesses (also on --resume)

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.162

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.154
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [keyboard-shortcuts] ←←: Open agents view
+ [slash-commands] /workflows: View dynamic workflow runs
+ [slash-commands] /chrome: Select connected browser for Chrome integration
+ [slash-commands] /logout: Sign out (in agents view)
+ [cli-flags] claude --bg --exec '<cmd>': Run shell command as attachable background session
+ [config-env] defaultEnabled: Plugin default disabled in plugin.json; enable with /plugin
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID: Session ID passed to stdio MCP server subprocesses
+ [skills-agents] /simplify: Cleanup-only review (reuse, simplify, efficiency, altitude) and apply fixes
+ [workflows-tips] Dynamic workflows: Ask Claude to create; orchestrates tens to hundreds of agents
~ [slash-commands] /effort [level]: Set effort; interactive slider (low–max; Faster/Smarter labels)
~ [skills-agents] Workflow: Dynamic multi-agent orchestration (opt-in); /workflows to view runs
~ [workflows-tips] 1M context: Opus 4.8 (Max/Team/Ent)
~ [workflows-tips] /effort: ○ low · ◐ med · ◑ xhigh · ● high/max (Faster↔Smarter)
~ [mcp-servers] claude mcp list: List all servers (⏸ = pending approval)
- [keyboard-shortcuts] Ctrl+U
- [slash-commands] /scroll-speed
- [slash-commands] /color [color]
- [slash-commands] /tui [fullscreen]
- [cli-flags] --channels
- [config-env] worktree.baseRef
- [config-env] OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_ENTRYPOINT

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.153
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

~ [slash-commands] /model [model]: Switch model (←→ effort, s = this session only)

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.152
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [slash-commands] /reload-skills: Re-scan skill directories without restarting
+ [skills-agents] disallowed-tools: Remove tools from model while skill is active
+ [config-env] pluginSuggestionMarketplaces: Allowlist org marketplaces for plugin suggestions
+ [config-env] reloadSkills: SessionStart: re-scan skills so new ones are available
+ [config-env] sessionTitle: SessionStart: set session title on startup and resume
+ [config-env] MessageDisplay: Transform or hide assistant message text as displayed
+ [cli-flags] --fallback-model: Switch to this model when primary is not found
+ [keyboard-shortcuts] / (vim NORMAL): Reverse history search (like Ctrl+R)
~ [skills-agents] /code-review [effort]: Code review with effort; --comment for inline PR comments, --fix to apply findings
~ [workflows-tips] Auto mode: No opt-in consent needed; built-in for Max subscribers
- [config-env] ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_SERVICE_TIER
- [config-env] DISABLE_UPDATES
- [config-env] PostToolUseFailure
- [config-env] PermissionDenied
- [config-env] PreCompact
- [cli-flags] --exclude-dynamic-system-prompt-sections
- [keyboard-shortcuts] Ctrl+E
- [slash-commands] /chrome
